Question: Show me which chat channels has user_0164 posted in?

SELECT COALESCE(cc.name, 'DM ' || cc.id::text) AS channel, COUNT(*) AS messages FROM chat_messages cm JOIN chat_channels cc ON cc.id=cm.chat_channel_id JOIN users u ON u.id=cm.user_id WHERE u.username = 'user_0164' GROUP BY cc.id, cc.name ORDER BY messages DESC, channel LIMIT 20;

Question: Show me which 5 users wrote the most posts in the last 1 days?

SELECT u.username, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id WHERE p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY post_count DESC, u.username LIMIT 5;

Question: Show me which 10 topics have the most likes in the last 1 days?

SELECT t.id, t.title, COUNT(pa.id) AS like_count FROM topics t JOIN posts p ON p.topic_id=t.id JOIN post_actions pa ON pa.post_id=p.id AND pa.post_action_type_id=2 WHERE pa.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 days' GROUP BY t.id, t.title ORDER BY like_count DESC, t.id LIMIT 10;

Question: Show me which categories have the most topics tagged ai?

SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS topic_count FROM topics t JOIN categories c ON c.id=t.category_id JOIN topic_tags tt ON tt.topic_id=t.id JOIN tags tg ON tg.id=tt.tag_id WHERE tg.name = 'ai' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY topic_count DESC, c.name LIMIT 10;
